
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Biloti Pizza</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/webp" href="data:image/webp;base64,">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#1d130c;--w1:#9a6236;--w2:#65401f;--wd:#3d2410;--tx:#ffe9c4;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#140d08}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#140d08}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;background:var(--bg);font-family:'Baloo 2',system-ui,sans-serif;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;touch-action:none;overflow:hidden;color:#fff}
#app{position:fixed;inset:0;margin:auto;max-width:480px;overflow:hidden;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#4a2e18 0 46px,#42281 0 48px),#4a2e18}
.scr{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:12px 12px;padding-top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));padding-bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#6b4425,#2c1a0e 70%)}
.scr.on{display:flex}
.wood{background:linear-gradient(var(--w1),var(--w2));border:3px solid var(--wd);border-radius:12px;color:var(--tx);box-shadow:0 3px 0 #0006,inset 0 2px 0 #fff3}
.logo{text-align:center;line-height:.85;margin-top:26px;padding:10px 26px 12px;background:linear-gradient(#f6dfb0,#e3bd82);border:4px solid #8a5a2b;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #0006}
.logo b{display:block;font-size:56px;font-weight:800;color:#e8432d;-webkit-text-stroke:2px #7a2214;paint-order:stroke fill;letter-spacing:1px}.logo b+b{color:#4f8a2f;-webkit-text-stroke-color:#24440f;font-size:62px}
.big{font-size:110px;line-height:1;margin:8px 0}
.btn{width:100%;max-width:270px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:6px 12px;margin:5px;font:800 22px 'Baloo 2',sans-serif;color:var(--tx);background:linear-gradient(#a8703f,#744a24);border:3px solid var(--wd);box-shadow:0 4px 0 #0006,inset 0 2px 0 #fff3;touch-action:manipulation}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(3px)}.btn.g{background:linear-gradient(#5fc65a,#2e8a35);color:#fff}
.bar{width:80%;height:22px;border-radius:12px;border:3px solid #fff8;background:#0006;overflow:hidden;margin-top:12px}.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(#8f8,#2b4)}
.hud{display:flex;width:100%;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.pill{padding:1px 12px;border-radius:18px;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;white-space:nowrap}
.plq{flex:1;text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:20px;padding:1px 4px}
.cust{display:flex;width:100%;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;min-height:130px}
.catw{width:104px;text-align:center;flex:0 0 auto}
#cat{font-size:78px;line-height:1;animation:in .5s}
@keyframes in{from{transform:translateX(-140px);opacity:0}}
#nm{font-weight:800;font-size:14px}
.pat{height:9px;border-radius:6px;background:#0007;overflow:hidden;margin-top:2px}.pat i{display:block;height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f55,#fd5,#5d5)}
#bub{flex:1;position:relative;background:#fffaf0;color:#3a2412;border-radius:16px;padding:8px 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;line-height:1.2}
#bub:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-9px;top:34px;border:9px solid transparent;border-right-color:#fffaf0;border-left:0}
.ch{display:inline-block;margin:3px 3px 0 0;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:12px;background:#f1e2c4;font-size:15px}.ch.ok{background:#9be28d}.ch.bad{background:#ff9a8f}
#board{flex:1;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:0;position:relative}
#pc{touch-action:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 6px #0007)}
#board.fly #pc{animation:fly .9s ease-in forwards}@keyframes fly{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(.15) rotate(-25deg);opacity:0}}
#tray{display:flex;gap:8px;width:100%;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px;touch-action:pan-x;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(var(--w1),var(--w2));border:3px solid var(--wd);flex:0 0 auto}
.it{flex:0 0 auto;width:68px;text-align:center;font:700 12px 'Baloo 2';color:var(--tx);background:#0003;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 0;touch-action:none}
.it canvas{display:block;margin:auto;pointer-events:none}
.gh{position:fixed;width:80px;height:80px;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.1);z-index:99}
.x{position:absolute;top:calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));left:8px;display:none}
.ov{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000b;display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;z-index:9;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;padding:20px}.ov.on{display:flex}
.rib{font:800 34px 'Baloo 2';padding:2px 26px;background:linear-gradient(#e7ae5a,#b9742f);border:3px solid #6b3d14;color:#fff5dc;border-radius:8px;text-shadow:0 2px 0 #0005}.rib.p{background:linear-gradient(#9b6bd6,#5e3a9e);border-color:#3b2370}
.ttl{font:800 28px 'Baloo 2';padding:2px 30px;margin:26px 0 10px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:9px;width:100%;overflow:auto;touch-action:pan-y}
.card{background:linear-gradient(#f6e6c6,#dcc08f);border:3px solid #8a5a2b;border-radius:12px;text-align:center;padding:4px 2px;color:#3a2412;font:800 14px/1.1 'Baloo 2';touch-action:manipulation}
.card canvas{display:block;margin:auto}.card small{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.card .pr{margin:3px auto 0;width:80%;border-radius:10px;background:#3b9a3b;color:#fff;font-size:13px}.card.lk .pr{background:#6b5a48}.card.lk canvas{opacity:.45}
#toast{position:absolute;bottom:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));left:12px;right:12px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;color:#ffe9c4;min-height:26px}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;width:100%;max-width:300px;padding:10px 14px;margin:6px 0;font-weight:800;font-size:20px}
.tg{width:54px;height:28px;border-radius:16px;background:#777;position:relative}.tg.on{background:#3ab04a}.tg:after{content:'';position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:.15s}.tg.on:after{left:29px}
.fl{position:fixed;font:800 28px 'Baloo 2';color:#ffd84a;text-shadow:0 2px 0 #000a;pointer-events:none;animation:up 1.2s forwards;z-index:98}@keyframes up{to{transform:translateY(-80px);opacity:0}}
.bm{position:fixed;font:800 44px 'Baloo 2';white-space:nowrap;color:#ffe14d;-webkit-text-stroke:2px #b3261e;paint-order:stroke fill;text-shadow:0 3px 0 #7a1b14;pointer-events:none;z-index:99;animation:bm 1.8s forwards}@keyframes bm{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.2) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}15%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.25) rotate(-8deg);opacity:1}30%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1) rotate(-8deg)}85%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-80%) scale(1) rotate(-8deg);opacity:0}}
#oven{position:absolute;top:0;right:2px;width:84px;height:64px;border-radius:40px 40px 8px 8px;background:linear-gradient(#a0432a,#6e2a18);border:3px solid #3d1a0e;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;box-shadow:inset 0 -26px 0 #1a0c06;color:#ffd9a8}#oven span{position:absolute;bottom:12px;font-size:24px}#oven.hot{animation:hotp .7s infinite;box-shadow:0 0 20px #ff8a2a,inset 0 -26px 0 #1a0c06}@keyframes hotp{50%{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.lg{width:min(80%,340px);margin:auto 0;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 10px #0009);animation:bob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}.lg.s{width:min(66%,270px);margin:14px 0 8px}@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-8px) rotate(1deg)}}
.pz{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:99;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation:pz 1s ease-out forwards}@keyframes pz{to{transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx)),calc(-50% + var(--dy) + 70px)) rotate(var(--rot));opacity:0}}.lg.sq{animation:sq .25s}@keyframes sq{50%{transform:scale(.92)}}
.hop{animation:hop .45s 3}@keyframes hop{50%{transform:translateY(-22px) scale(1.12)}}#bub.pulse{animation:pl .5s 2}@keyframes pl{50%{transform:scale(1.07)}}#game:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:12px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffd34d 3px,#0000 4px) 0 4px/26px 12px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ffb);z-index:3;pointer-events:none}
</style></head><body>
<div id="app">
<div id="load" class="scr on"><img class="lg" alt="Biloti Pizza" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><div style="font-weight:700">Loading... <span id="lp">0</span>%</div><div class="bar"><i id="lb"></i></div></div>

<div id="menu" class="scr"><img class="lg s" alt="Biloti Pizza" id="mlg">
<button class="btn" onclick="go('game')">Start Game</button><button class="btn" onclick="go('rec')">Recipe Book</button><button class="btn" onclick="go('shop')">Shop</button><button class="btn" onclick="go('set')">Settings</button></div>

<div id="game" class="scr"><div class="hud"><span class="pill wood">🪙 <span id="cn"></span></span><div class="plq wood">🐾 BILOTI PIZZA</div><span class="pill wood">🐱 <span id="pg">0/5</span></span></div>
<div class="hud" style="margin-top:4px;font-weight:800"><span id="lv"></span><span id="hr"></span></div>
<div class="cust"><div class="catw"><div id="cat">😺</div><div id="nm"></div><div class="pat"><i id="pt"></i></div></div><div id="bub"></div></div>
<div id="board"><div id="oven"><span>🔥</span>OVEN</div><canvas id="pc"></canvas></div><div id="tray"></div>
<div class="ov" id="ov"></div></div>

<div id="shop" class="scr"><div class="hud"><span class="pill wood">🪙 <span class="cn"></span></span></div><div class="ttl wood">🐾 SHOP 🐾</div><div class="grid" id="sg"></div></div>
<div id="rec" class="scr"><div class="hud"><span class="pill wood">🪙 <span class="cn"></span></span></div><div class="ttl wood">🐾 RECIPE BOOK 🐾</div><div class="grid" id="rg" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr"></div></div>
<div id="set" class="scr"><div class="ttl wood">🐾 SETTINGS 🐾</div><div class="row wood">🎵 Music <div class="tg" id="tm"></div></div><div class="row wood">🔊 Sound <div class="tg" id="ts"></div></div><div class="row wood">📳 Vibration <div class="tg" id="tv"></div></div></div>
<button class="btn x" id="bk" style="width:44px;padding:0;margin:0" onclick="go('menu')">←</button>
<div id="toast"></div>
</div>
<script>
const $=i=>document.getElementById(i),Q=s=>document.querySelectorAll(s);
const ING={cheese:{n:'Cheese',e:'🧀',p:0},onion:{n:'Onion',e:'🧅',p:0},tomato:{n:'Tomato',e:'🍅',p:0},mushroom:{n:'Mushroom',e:'🍄',p:15},olive:{n:'Olive',e:'🫒',p:30},capsicum:{n:'Capsicum',e:'🫑',p:50},corn:{n:'Corn',e:'🌽',p:75},pineapple:{n:'Pineapple',e:'🍍',p:120},bacon:{n:'Bacon',e:'🥓',p:150},chicken:{n:'Chicken',e:'🍗',p:180},fish:{n:'Fish',e:'🐟',p:220}};
const REC=[{n:'Cheese Delight',s:'red',i:{cheese:5},p:0},{n:'Veggie Supreme',s:'red',i:{cheese:4,onion:4,tomato:4},p:0},{n:'Farm House',s:'white',i:{tomato:4,mushroom:4,corn:5},p:50},{n:'Meat Lover',s:'bbq',i:{cheese:4,bacon:4,chicken:5},p:100},{n:'Hawaiian',s:'red',i:{cheese:4,pineapple:5,bacon:4},p:150},{n:'Seafood',s:'white',i:{fish:5,olive:4,tomato:4},p:200}];
Object.assign(ING,{sauce_red:{n:'Red Sauce',e:'🥫',p:0},sauce_white:{n:'White Sauce',e:'🥛',p:40},sauce_bbq:{n:'BBQ Sauce',e:'🍖',p:60}});const SC={sauce_red:'#d8412a',sauce_white:'#f6efd8',sauce_bbq:'#6a2c12'};
const CATS=[['🐱','Mochi'],['😺','Luna'],['🐯','Tiger'],['🦁','Simba'],['😸','Mimi'],['🐈‍⬛','Oreo']];
let S={coins:20,ing:['sauce_red','cheese','onion','tomato'],rec:[0,1],lv:1,snd:1,vib:1,mus:1};
try{Object.assign(S,JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('bp')||'{}'))}catch(e){}
if(!S.ing.includes('sauce_red'))S.ing.unshift('sauce_red');const sv=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('bp',JSON.stringify(S))}catch(e){}};
let AC;const ac=()=>{if(!AC)AC=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();AC.resume();return AC};
function tone(f,d=.1,v=.1,ty='square'){if(!S.snd)return;try{const a=ac(),t=a.currentTime,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=ty;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,t);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f*1.5,t+d);g.gain.setValueAtTime(v,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+d);o.connect(g).connect(a.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+d)}catch(e){}}
const ML=[76,0,79,0,84,0,79,76,81,0,77,0,76,0,72,0,77,0,81,0,84,0,81,77,79,0,83,0,86,0,83,79],BS=[48,0,0,0,55,0,0,0,45,0,0,0,52,0,0,0,41,0,0,0,48,0,0,0,43,0,0,0,50,0,0,0];let mu=null;
function mnote(a,m,n,t,d,ty,v){const o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();o.type=ty;o.frequency.value=440*Math.pow(2,(n-69)/12);g.gain.setValueAtTime(v,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+d);o.connect(g).connect(m);o.start(t);o.stop(t+d+.02)}
function music(){if(!S.mus){if(mu){clearInterval(mu.h);mu.m.disconnect();mu=null}return}if(mu)return;try{const a=ac(),m=a.createGain();m.gain.value=.12;m.connect(a.destination);mu={m,h:0,t:a.currentTime+.1,i:0};mu.h=setInterval(()=>{while(mu&&mu.t<a.currentTime+.4){const i=mu.i%32,n=ML[i],b=BS[i];if(n){mnote(a,m,n,mu.t,.5,'triangle',.5);mnote(a,m,n+12,mu.t,.25,'sine',.12)}if(b)mnote(a,m,b,mu.t,.9,'sine',.45);mu.t+=.28;mu.i++}},100)}catch(e){}}
function meow(sad){if(!S.snd)return;try{const a=ac(),T0=a.currentTime+.03,N=30,re=new Float32Array(N+1),im=new Float32Array(N+1);for(let n=1;n<=N;n++)im[n]=1/Math.pow(n,1.15);const w=a.createPeriodicWave(re,im);[[0,1,.62],[.78,.9,.5]].forEach(([d,pm,L])=>{const t=T0+d,p=(sad?.7:1)*pm*620,o=a.createOscillator(),vb=a.createOscillator(),vg=a.createGain(),g=a.createGain(),f1=a.createBiquadFilter(),f2=a.createBiquadFilter(),f3=a.createBiquadFilter(),m=a.createGain();o.setPeriodicWave(w);o.frequency.setValueAtTime(p*.8,t);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(p*1.7,t+.16);o.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(p*1.5,t+.36);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(p*.8,t+L);vb.frequency.value=6;vg.gain.value=p*.025;vb.connect(vg).connect(o.frequency);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.9,t+.09);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.9,t+L*.6);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+L);f1.type=f2.type=f3.type='bandpass';f1.Q.value=f2.Q.value=7;f3.Q.value=5;f1.frequency.setValueAtTime(500,t);f1.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(950,t+L*.7);f2.frequency.setValueAtTime(2700,t);f2.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(1400,t+L*.7);f3.frequency.value=3600;m.gain.value=sad?1.6:2.4;[f1,f2,f3].forEach(f=>{o.connect(f);f.connect(g)});g.connect(m).connect(a.destination);o.start(t);vb.start(t);o.stop(t+L+.03);vb.stop(t+L+.03)})}catch(e){}}
const vib=n=>{if(S.vib&&navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(n)};
function dr(c,t,x,y,s,k){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(s*6.28);if(k)c.scale(k,k);
  if(t==='cheese'){for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const a=i*2.4+s*9,d=((i*37+s*50)%26);c.save();c.translate(Math.cos(a)*d,Math.sin(a)*d);c.rotate(a*3);c.fillStyle=i%2?'#ffd54a':'#ffe58a';c.fillRect(-6,-1.8,12,3.6);c.restore()}}
  else if(t==='onion'){c.strokeStyle='#b46ad8';c.lineWidth=4;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,14,0,6.29);c.stroke();c.strokeStyle='#e6c3f5';c.lineWidth=2.5;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,8,0,6.29);c.stroke()}
  else if(t==='tomato'){c.fillStyle='#d9322a';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,16,0,6.29);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#ff6a55';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,11,0,6.29);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#ffd27a';for(let i=0;i<4;i++)c.fillRect(Math.cos(i*1.57)*6-1,Math.sin(i*1.57)*6-1,3,3)}
  else if(t==='mushroom'){c.fillStyle='#ecdcbc';c.strokeStyle='#a98a5b';c.lineWidth=1.5;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,-2,15,Math.PI,0);c.fill();c.stroke();c.fillRect(-5,-2,10,12);c.strokeRect(-5,-2,10,12)}
  else if(t==='olive'){c.strokeStyle='#2c2b3a';c.lineWidth=5;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,8,0,6.29);c.stroke()}
  else if(t==='capsicum'){c.strokeStyle='#3fae3a';c.lineWidth=6;c.lineCap='round';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,13,.4,2.7);c.stroke()}
  else if(t==='corn'){c.fillStyle='#ffd23a';[[0,0],[7,4],[-7,3],[3,-7],[-4,-6]].forEach(p=>{c.beginPath();c.arc(p[0],p[1],4.5,0,6.29);c.fill()})}
  else if(SC[t]){c.fillStyle='#8a5a2b';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,19,0,6.29);c.fill();c.fillStyle=SC[t];c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,14,0,6.29);c.fill();c.fillStyle='#ff8a70';c.beginPath();c.arc(-4,-4,4,0,6.29);c.fill()}
  else{c.rotate(-s*6.28);c.font='30px serif';c.textAlign='center';c.textBaseline='middle';c.fillText(ING[t].e,0,0)}
  c.restore()}
const HR=t=>t==='cheese'?30:22;
function icon(t,sz,k){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=sz*2;c.style.cssText='width:'+sz+'px;height:'+sz+'px';const x=c.getContext('2d');x.scale(2,2);dr(x,t,sz/2,sz/2,.3,k||1);return c}
function crust(c,cx,cy,R,s){c.fillStyle='#d28d42';c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cy,R,0,6.29);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#a8692a';c.lineWidth=3;c.stroke();c.fillStyle='#e9b369';c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cy,R-6,0,6.29);c.fill();c.fillStyle=s?'#d8412a':'#f1c987';c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cy,R-14,0,6.29);c.fill();c.fillStyle=s?'#ee6a4c':'#e6b873';for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const a=i*2.1,d=(i*13%(R-30));c.beginPath();c.arc(cx+Math.cos(a)*d,cy+Math.sin(a)*d,4,0,6.29);c.fill()}}
let cur='load',G=null,D=null,C=null,P=null,cs=300,dpr=2;
const pc=$('pc'),pg=pc.getContext('2d');
function size(){cs=Math.max(200,Math.min($('app').clientWidth-30,$('board').clientHeight-6));pc.width=cs*dpr;pc.height=cs*dpr;pc.style.width=pc.style.height=cs+'px'}
function toast(t){$('toast').textContent=t;clearTimeout(toast.h);toast.h=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').textContent='',2200)}
function go(id){Q('.scr').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('on'));$(id).classList.add('on');cur=id;$('bk').style.display=id==='game'||id==='menu'||id==='load'?'none':'block';if(id==='game'){$('bk').style.display='block';tray();size();startLevel()}if(id==='shop')shop();if(id==='rec')recs();if(id==='set')sets();$('toast').textContent='';ui()}
function ui(){Q('.cn,#cn').forEach(e=>e.textContent=S.coins);sv()}
let lp=0;const li=setInterval(()=>{lp+=3;$('lp').textContent=Math.min(lp,100);$('lb').style.width=Math.min(lp,100)+'%';if(lp>=100){clearInterval(li);go('menu')}},50);
function tray(){const t=$('tray');t.innerHTML='';S.ing.slice().sort((a,b)=>!SC[a]-!SC[b]).forEach(k=>{const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='it';d.appendChild(icon(k,52));d.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',ING[k].n);d.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();ac();begin(k,Math.random(),e)});t.appendChild(d)})}
function gh(t,s){const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=160;c.className='gh';const x=c.getContext('2d');x.scale(2,2);dr(x,t,40,40,s);document.body.appendChild(c);return c}
function begin(t,s,e){if(!G||G.state!=='play')return;D={t,s,g:gh(t,s)};mv(e);tone(500,.06)}
function mv(e){if(C){const r=pc.getBoundingClientRect();C.x1=e.clientX-r.left;C.y1=e.clientY-r.top;return}if(P){P.cx=e.clientX;P.cy=e.clientY;P.tx=e.clientX-P.x;P.ty=e.clientY-P.y;pc.style.transform='translate('+P.tx+'px,'+P.ty+'px)';return}if(!D)return;D.x=e.clientX;D.y=e.clientY-45;D.g.style.left=D.x+'px';D.g.style.top=D.y+'px';if(SC[D.t]&&G&&G.state==='play')paint()}
function paint(){const r=pc.getBoundingClientRect(),R=cs*.45,cx=cs/2,x=D.x-r.left,y=D.y-r.top;if(Math.hypot(x-cx,y-cx)>R-4)return;if(D.t!=='sauce_'+G.rec.s){if(!G.wr||Date.now()-G.wr>1500){G.wr=Date.now();pop('Wrong sauce! 🙀',D.x-40,D.y)}return}const c=G.sc;c.save();c.beginPath();c.arc(cx,cx,R-12,0,6.29);c.clip();c.globalAlpha=.85+Math.random()*.15;c.fillStyle=SC[D.t];c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,22,0,6.29);c.fill();c.restore();const N=16,w=cs/N;for(let i=0;i<N;i++)for(let j=0;j<N;j++)if(Math.hypot((i+.5)*w-x,(j+.5)*w-y)<24)G.sg[j*N+i]=1;if(Math.random()<.2)tone(110+Math.random()*60,.05,.05,'sine');check()}
function cover(){if(!G||!G.sg)return 0;const N=16,w=cs/N,R=cs*.45-14;let a=0,b=0;for(let i=0;i<N;i++)for(let j=0;j<N;j++)if(Math.hypot((i+.5)*w-cs/2,(j+.5)*w-cs/2)<=R){b++;if(G.sg[j*N+i])a++}return b?a/b:0}
addEventListener('pointermove',mv);
function drop(){if(C){endCut();return}if(P){endBake();return}if(!D)return;const r=pc.getBoundingClientRect(),R=cs*.45,cx=cs/2,x=D.x-r.left-cx,y=D.y-r.top-cx,d=Math.hypot(x,y);
  if(SC[D.t])tone(300,.08,.08,'sine');else if(d<=R+6&&G&&G.state==='play'&&cover()>=.7){const m=Math.min(1,(R-HR(D.t)*.6)/(d||1));G.items.push({t:D.t,x:cx+x*m,y:cx+y*m,s:D.s,a:performance.now()});tone(260,.1,.14,'sine');vib(15)}else{tone(180,.12,.08,'sawtooth');if(d<=R+6&&G&&G.state==='play')pop('Pehle sauce lagao! 🥫',D.x-60,D.y)}
  D.g.remove();D=null;check()}
addEventListener('pointerup',drop);addEventListener('pointercancel',drop);
pc.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();ac();if(G&&G.state==='cut'){const r=pc.getBoundingClientRect(),x=e.clientX-r.left,y=e.clientY-r.top;C={x0:x,y0:y,x1:x,y1:y};return}if(G&&G.state==='bake'){P={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};return}if(!G||G.state!=='play')return;const r=pc.getBoundingClientRect(),x=e.clientX-r.left,y=e.clientY-r.top;
  for(let i=G.items.length-1;i>=0;i--){const it=G.items[i];if(Math.hypot(it.x-x,it.y-y)<HR(it.t)){G.items.splice(i,1);begin(it.t,it.s,e);check();return}}});
function startLevel(){G={lv:S.lv,done:0,lives:3,earn:0,items:[],state:'wait'};$('ov').classList.remove('on');cust()}
function cust(){const ri=S.rec[Math.random()*S.rec.length|0],rc=REC[ri],c=CATS[Math.random()*6|0];G.rec=rc;G.n=Object.values(rc.i).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);G.rew=Math.round(G.n*1.5);G.max=G.t=Math.max(40,32+G.n*4-Math.min(G.lv,8)*1.5);G.items=[];G.cat=c;pc.style.transition='';pc.style.transform='';C=P=null;G.cuts=[];G.baked=0;G.bd=0;G.bt=0;{const sc=document.createElement('canvas');sc.width=sc.height=cs*dpr;G.scv=sc;G.sc=sc.getContext('2d');G.sc.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);G.sg=new Uint8Array(256)}
  const ct=$('cat');ct.textContent=c[0];ct.style.animation='none';void ct.offsetWidth;ct.style.animation='';$('nm').textContent=c[1];G.state='play';check();hud()}
function hud(){$('pg').textContent=G.done+'/5';$('lv').textContent='Level '+G.lv;$('hr').textContent='❤️'.repeat(G.lives)+'🤍'.repeat(3-G.lives);ui()}
function counts(){const c={};G.items.forEach(i=>c[i.t]=(c[i.t]||0)+1);return c}
function check(){if(!G||G.state!=='play')return;const c=counts(),need=G.rec.i,cv=cover();let ok=cv>=.7,h='Meow meow! I want <b>'+G.rec.n+'</b> pizza! 🍕<br><span class="ch '+(cv>=.7?'ok':'')+'">🥫 '+ING['sauce_'+G.rec.s].n+' '+Math.round(Math.min(cv/.7,1)*100)+'%</span>';
  for(const k in need){const v=c[k]||0;if(v!==need[k])ok=false;h+='<span class="ch '+(v===need[k]?'ok':v>need[k]?'bad':'')+'">'+ING[k].e+' '+v+'/'+need[k]+'</span>'}
  for(const k in c)if(!need[k]){ok=false;h+='<span class="ch bad">'+ING[k].e+' no!</span>'}
  h+='<br><small>Reward 🪙 '+G.rew+'</small>';$('bub').innerHTML=h;if(ok){G.state='cut';G.cuts=[];cutMsg();tone(700,.12,.12);tone(900,.2,.12)}}
function cutMsg(){$('bub').innerHTML='Perfect! 😻 Ab <b>✂️ kaato</b>: pizza ke beech se 3 baar swipe karo <span class="ch">'+G.cuts.length+'/3</span>'}
function endCut(){const c=C;C=null;if(!G||G.state!=='cut')return;const r=pc.getBoundingClientRect(),dx=c.x1-c.x0,dy=c.y1-c.y0,L=Math.hypot(dx,dy),h=cs/2,px=r.left+h-40,py=r.top+h;if(L<cs*.5){pop('Lamba swipe karo ✂️',px,py);return}const d=Math.abs(dx*(c.y0-h)-dy*(c.x0-h))/L;if(d>cs*.18){pop('Beech se kaato! ✂️',px,py);return}const a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);if(G.cuts.some(b=>Math.abs(Math.sin(a-b))<.3)){pop('Alag angle se! ✂️',px,py);return}G.cuts.push(a);tone(900,.06,.12);tone(600,.1,.1);vib(20);if(G.cuts.length>=3){G.state='bake';$('bub').innerHTML='Slices ready! 🍕 Ab pizza ko <b>oven 🔥</b> mein drag karo!';tone(1000,.15,.12)}else cutMsg()}
function endBake(){const p=P;P=null;if(!G||G.state!=='bake')return;const o=$('oven').getBoundingClientRect(),pr=pc.getBoundingClientRect();if(p.cx!=null&&p.cx>o.left-15&&p.cx<o.right+15&&p.cy>o.top-15&&p.cy<o.bottom+15){const ocx=pr.left+pr.width/2-(p.tx||0),ocy=pr.top+pr.height/2-(p.ty||0);G.state='baking';G.bt=0;pc.style.transition='transform .4s';pc.style.transform='translate('+(o.left+o.width/2-ocx)+'px,'+(o.top+o.height/2-ocy)+'px) scale(.25)';tone(300,.2,.1)}else{pc.style.transition='transform .3s';pc.style.transform='';setTimeout(()=>pc.style.transition='',350);pop('Oven mein chhodo! 🔥',pr.left+pr.width/2-60,pr.top+20)}}
function pop(t,x,y){const e=document.createElement('div');e.className='fl';e.textContent=t;e.style.left=x+'px';e.style.top=y+'px';document.body.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),1200)}
function serve(){G.state='serve';const fast=G.t/G.max>.5,bn=fast?Math.round(G.n/2):0,tot=G.rew+bn;G.earn+=tot;S.coins+=tot;const ct=$('cat').getBoundingClientRect(),pr=pc.getBoundingClientRect(),bd=$('board');bd.style.setProperty('--dx',(ct.left+ct.width/2-pr.left-pr.width/2)+'px');bd.style.setProperty('--dy',(ct.top+ct.height/2-pr.top-pr.height/2)+'px');$('cat').textContent='😋';$('bub').innerHTML='Nam nam nam... 😋';bd.classList.add('fly');tone(400,.15,.1);vib(30);ui();
  setTimeout(()=>{const cat=$('cat'),b=$('bub');cat.textContent='😻';cat.style.animation='hop .45s 3';b.innerHTML='Meow meow!! 😻 Purrfect!<br><b>+'+tot+' 🪙</b>'+(fast?' <span class="ch ok">⚡ Fast +'+bn+'</span>':'');b.classList.remove('pulse');void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add('pulse');meow();vib([30,40,30]);[0,120,240].forEach(d=>setTimeout(()=>tone(660+d*2,.14,.12),d));burst(ct);hud()},800);
  setTimeout(()=>{bd.classList.remove('fly');G.items=[];G.done++;nxt()},2400)}
function burst(r){const e=['💕','❤️','✨','💖','🪙'];for(let i=0;i<10;i++)setTimeout(()=>{const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='fl';d.style.fontSize='24px';d.textContent=e[i%5];d.style.left=(r.left+Math.random()*r.width)+'px';d.style.top=(r.top+Math.random()*r.height*.6)+'px';document.body.appendChild(d);setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),1200)},i*70);bm(r)}
function bm(r){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='bm';d.textContent='MEOW! MEOW! 😻';d.style.left=innerWidth/2+'px';d.style.top=(r.top+r.height/2)+'px';document.body.appendChild(d);setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),1800)}
function fail(){G.state='fail';G.lives--;$('cat').textContent='😿';$('bub').innerHTML='Meow... I am leaving 😿';meow(1);vib(120);hud();setTimeout(()=>{G.items=[];G.done++;nxt()},1100)}
function ov(h){$('ov').innerHTML=h;$('ov').classList.add('on')}
function nxt(){hud();if(G.lives<=0){G.state='end';ov('<div class="rib p">GAME OVER</div><div class="big">😿</div>Oh no! The customer left sad...<br>Try again!<button class="btn g" onclick="startLevel()">↻ Try Again</button><button class="btn" onclick="go(\'menu\')">Menu</button>');return}
  if(G.done>=5){G.state='end';meow();ov('<div class="rib">LEVEL '+G.lv+' COMPLETE!</div><div class="big">😻</div>You earned 🪙 '+G.earn+'<br><small>Spend coins in Shop and Recipe Book!</small><button class="btn g" onclick="S.lv++;startLevel()">▶ Next Order</button><button class="btn" onclick="go(\'shop\')">Shop</button><button class="btn" onclick="go(\'menu\')">Menu</button>');return}
  cust()}
function shop(){const g=$('sg');g.innerHTML='';for(const k in ING){const o=S.ing.includes(k),d=document.createElement('div');d.className='card'+(o?'':' lk');d.appendChild(icon(k,56,1.3));d.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',ING[k].n+'<div class="pr">'+(o?'✓ Owned':'🪙 '+ING[k].p)+'</div>');
  d.onclick=()=>{if(o)return;if(S.coins>=ING[k].p){S.coins-=ING[k].p;S.ing.push(k);tone(880,.2,.14);toast(ING[k].n+' unlocked! 🎉')}else toast('Need '+(ING[k].p-S.coins)+' more coins 🪙');ui();shop()};g.appendChild(d)}}
function recs(){const g=$('rg');g.innerHTML='';REC.forEach((r,i)=>{const o=S.rec.includes(i),d=document.createElement('div');d.className='card'+(o?'':' lk');const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=180;c.style.cssText='width:90px;height:90px';const x=c.getContext('2d');x.scale(2,2);crust(x,45,45,42,true);let n=0;const tot=Object.values(r.i).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);for(const k in r.i)for(let j=0;j<r.i[k];j++){const a=n*6.28/tot+.4,dd=n%2?14:24;dr(x,k,45+Math.cos(a)*dd,45+Math.sin(a)*dd,j*.37,.5);n++}d.appendChild(c);
  d.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',r.n+'<small>'+ING['sauce_'+r.s].n+' · '+Object.keys(r.i).map(k=>ING[k].e+'×'+r.i[k]).join(' ')+'</small><div class="pr">'+(o?'✓ Unlocked':'🪙 '+r.p)+'</div>');
  d.onclick=()=>{if(o)return;const miss=Object.keys(r.i).concat('sauce_'+r.s).filter(k=>!S.ing.includes(k));if(miss.length)toast('Unlock '+miss.map(k=>ING[k].n).join(', ')+' in Shop first!');else if(S.coins<r.p)toast('Need '+(r.p-S.coins)+' more coins 🪙');else{S.coins-=r.p;S.rec.push(i);tone(880,.2,.14);toast(r.n+' unlocked! 🍕')}ui();recs()};g.appendChild(d)})}
function sets(){[['tm','mus'],['ts','snd'],['tv','vib']].forEach(([id,k])=>{const e=$(id);e.className='tg'+(S[k]?' on':'');e.onclick=()=>{S[k]^=1;e.className='tg'+(S[k]?' on':'');sv();music()}})}
let last=performance.now();
(function loop(n){const dt=Math.min(.05,(n-last)/1000);last=n;
  if(cur==='game'&&G){if(G.state==='play'||G.state==='cut'||G.state==='bake'){G.t-=dt;if(G.t<=0)fail()}if(G.state==='baking'){G.bt+=dt;$('bub').innerHTML='Baking... 🔥 '+Math.max(1,Math.ceil(3-G.bt))+'s';if(G.bt>=3&&!G.bd){G.bd=1;G.baked=1;tone(1200,.3,.15);pc.style.transform='';setTimeout(()=>{pc.style.transition='';serve()},900)}}$('oven').classList.toggle('hot',G.state==='bake'||G.state==='baking');$('pt').style.width=Math.max(0,G.t/G.max*100)+'%';
    pg.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);pg.clearRect(0,0,cs,cs);pg.fillStyle='#7a4a26';pg.beginPath();pg.arc(cs/2,cs/2,cs*.45+10,0,6.29);pg.fill();pg.strokeStyle='#5a3318';pg.lineWidth=3;pg.stroke();crust(pg,cs/2,cs/2,cs*.45);if(G.scv)pg.drawImage(G.scv,0,0,cs,cs);const nw=performance.now();G.items.forEach(i=>dr(pg,i.t,i.x,i.y,i.s,Math.min(1,.4+(nw-(i.a||0))/160*.6)));const bk=G.baked?1:G.state==='baking'?G.bt/3:0;if(bk>0){pg.fillStyle='rgba(150,70,10,'+.28*bk+')';pg.beginPath();pg.arc(cs/2,cs/2,cs*.45-4,0,6.29);pg.fill()}
(G.cuts||[]).forEach(a=>{pg.save();pg.translate(cs/2,cs/2);pg.rotate(a);pg.strokeStyle='rgba(50,25,8,.7)';pg.lineWidth=2.5;pg.beginPath();pg.moveTo(-cs*.45,0);pg.lineTo(cs*.45,0);pg.stroke();pg.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.35)';pg.lineWidth=1;pg.beginPath();pg.moveTo(-cs*.45,1.5);pg.lineTo(cs*.45,1.5);pg.stroke();pg.restore()});
if(C){pg.strokeStyle='#fff';pg.lineWidth=3;pg.setLineDash([6,6]);pg.beginPath();pg.moveTo(C.x0,C.y0);pg.lineTo(C.x1,C.y1);pg.stroke();pg.setLineDash([]);pg.font='34px serif';pg.textAlign='center';pg.fillText('🔪',C.x1,C.y1)}}
  requestAnimationFrame(loop)})(last);
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(cur==='game')size()});addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{ac();music()});
document.getElementById('mlg').src=document.querySelector('#load .lg').src;
$('mlg').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{ac();tone(500+Math.random()*300,.12,.12,'sine');const im=$('mlg');im.classList.add('sq');setTimeout(()=>im.classList.remove('sq'),260);for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='pz';d.textContent='🍕';const a=-Math.PI/2+(Math.random()-.5)*2.4,r=90+Math.random()*120;d.style.cssText='left:'+e.clientX+'px;top:'+e.clientY+'px;--dx:'+Math.cos(a)*r+'px;--dy:'+Math.sin(a)*r+'px;--rot:'+(Math.random()*360-180)+'deg;font-size:'+(24+Math.random()*20)+'px';document.body.appendChild(d);setTimeout(()=>d.remove(),1100)}});
ui();
</script></body></html>
